description: Check a captain's or boat's availability. Provide exactly one of captainSlug or boatId. Omit date to get available dates for the next 90 days; provide both date (YYYY-MM-DD) and durationHours to get bookable time slots for that date. Only departures that have not yet left (Chicago time) are listed, so a past date has no slots. Each slot lists its offeredDurations, and every entry carries the durationId to pass to get_quote, create_booking, or create_boat_rental (null means that length is offered but not bookable through the API). A captain trip that lists harborIds departs only from those harbors (ids as in get_captain's harbors): create_booking refuses any other harbor for that trip. Without harborIds, drive time rules out none of the captain's active harbors.
name: check_availability
title: Check Availability
